verdict.rationale: Codegen is a SaaS AI coding agent that processes customer code, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, zero-data-retention, or a policy against using customer data for model training. The listed settings (agent permissions, signed commits, telemetry) are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
